glosses: to partition
Partitionner.
einen Datenspeicher in Partitionen aufteilen

examples.text: Ein neuer Laufwerkbuchstabe wird hinzugefügt, wenn Sie den vorhandenen Speicherplatz auf der Festplatte partitionieren oder wenn Sie mehr physischen Speicherplatz auf dem Computer hinzufügen.
Für die Installation eines Linux-Systems können Sie die Festplatte ganz unterschiedlich partitionieren.
Die Rechner selbst sollten in mehrere Einheiten partitioniert sein, von denen jeder Kunde eine Scheibe mitsamt VLAN-Zugang bekommt.

Es kann durchaus hilfreich sein USB-Sticks zu partitionieren. Vor allem wenn ein USB-Stick mit einem Gerät verbunden werden soll, das mit der maximalen Größe des Sticks nicht umgehen kann, macht das Erstellen einer Partition mit der passenden Größe Sinn.
Zu den herausragenden Eigenschaften gehört die Möglichkeit, die Rechner in Windows-NT- und Unix-Systeme zu partitionieren und über Fibre-Channel-Komponenten mit Speichersubsystemen zu verbinden.

glosses: An action which divides a thing into parts, or separates one thing from another.

examples.text: And good from bad find no partition.

glosses: A part of something that has been divided.
An approach to division in which one asks what the size of each part is, rather than (as in quotition) how many parts there are.
The division of a territory into two or more autonomous ones.

examples.text: Monarchies where partition isn't prohibited risk weakening through parcellation and civil wars between the heirs.

glosses: A vertical structure that divides a room.

examples.text: a brick partition; lath and plaster partitions

glosses: That which divides or separates; that by which different things, or distinct parts of the same thing, are separated; boundary; dividing line or space.

examples.text: No sight could pass / Betwixt the nice partitions of the grass.

glosses: A part divided off by walls; an apartment; a compartment.
The severance of common or undivided interests, particularly in real estate. It may be effected by consent of parties, or by compulsion of law.
A section of a hard disk separately formatted.

examples.text: The epicenter of the disturbance is the partition currently housing a [personality construct array] retrieved from Contender AI 05-032 <+> 0816.

glosses: A division of a database or one of its constituting elements such as tables into separate independent parts.
A division of a data stream, such as a messaging queue or topic (often representing a unit of parallelism, and of fault tolerance).
A collection of non-empty, disjoint subsets of a set whose union is the set itself (i.e. all elements of the set are contained in exactly one of the subsets).
A musical score.
To divide something into parts, sections or shares.
To divide a region or country into two or more territories with separate political status.

examples.text: Poland was progressively partitioned by Russia, Austria, and Prussia in the late 18th century.

glosses: To separate or divide a room by a partition (ex. a wall), often use with off.
Découper en une partition.

examples.text: L'algorithme de McCluskey partitionne les monômes ayant un même nombre de variables en classes ou sous-ensembles de monômes de même rang (ou nombre de variables directes).

Dans le spout, les données sont transformées en tuples, l'équivalent Storm des lignes d'une table. Ces tuples sont partitionnés en lots et chaque lot est envoyé à un ou plusieurs bolts répartis sur le cluster.

glosses: dividere un hard disk in partizioni
Dividir algo en particiones.
Crear una o varias particiones en una unidad de almacenamiento.
